title: Haldi's Adventure
description: NCERT Class 2 English (Marigold): 'Haldi's Adventure'. New words, comprehension, action words (verbs), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Haldi's Adventure': garden, hen, morning, adventure.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Haldi's Adventure' mean (garden, hen, morning, adventure); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which word names a place with plants and flowers?
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: The hen ran into the garden.
I can run and jump in the park.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Haldi's Adventure' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Haldi's Adventure'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In the story, Haldi the hen goes on an ___.
Haldi the hen sets off on a big ___ in the garden.

exemplars: The hen ran into the garden.
I can run and jump in the park.

nodes.title: Action Words (Verbs)
nodes.teach_focus: A doing word (verb) tells what someone does: run, jump, eat, fly.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses action words (verbs) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of action words (verbs).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which word is an action word?

bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: The hen runs across the garden.
Birds fly and sing in the morning.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Haldi's Adventure'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Haldi's Adventure': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In the garden, I can see a ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.
A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: The hen ran into the garden.
I can run and jump in the park.

items.prompt: Which word names a place with plants and flowers?
In the story, Haldi the hen goes on an ___.
Haldi the hen sets off on a big ___ in the garden.
Which word is an action word?
